systems.owner: Office National d'Identification de la Population (ONIP), which constitutes and maintains it; held only on national territory
systems.tiers: not stated: created in law by Decree 22/07 of 2 March 2022, with compulsory registration and a national identification number given at first registration; the decree does not say it is in operation

systems.system: automatic update of the FGP through civil status
systems.country_label: mise à jour automatique à travers l'état civil
systems.owner: ONIP; authorities holding the data must communicate them regularly to the FGP (Article 11)
systems.tiers: not stated: provided for in the decree (Article 6.2), which also has the FGP hold birth and death act numbers and the registration numbers of a person's civil-status acts (Article 9); no operating link described

systems.country_label: registres communaux et territoriaux de la population
systems.tiers: communes and territories; the FGP is to harmonise their management with that of the civil-status registers (Article 6.8); nothing said of their form

systems.owner: not stated; governed by the Family Code
systems.tiers: not stated; named only as the registers the FGP is to be updated from and harmonised with

note: A decree creating the population file, an identity system. It names the civil-status registers only as a source for that file and states nothing about how a civil registration office records a birth or death. The captured text stops in Article 18.
